data.value: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?

It is the first week of October 2012, during the presidential campaign between Barack Obama and Mitt Romney. Major national polling organizations regularly conduct and release head-to-head surveys. The organizations listed are among those considered major national pollsters. Each organization decides independently whether and when to release a survey. The public release of a survey is an observable event.
